No problem, this is a frequent situation.
Here is what I propose for this specific case, using "gitk" tool (you'll need to adapt if using git commands or alternate tool, but that should be the same process globally. This being said, I recommend gitk tool):
- "Checkout" the branch you used to submit this PR. From what I can see it should be 'main'. (I suggest to create a specific branch with a specific name each time you want to push a new change, but that's for another time ;-) )
- "Reset branch" to the commit you need to modify (drivers: serial: Add Line Break Detection to stm32)
- Start "git gui"  (File/Start git gui, in gitk). In git gui, click "Amend" the commit 
- Do the required change (in your case, fix the commit message)
- Commit
- Force push using commands (`git push -f ....` )

review_comments:
It seems LDB detection is not available on some F0 variants.
This is then causing build issues on such targets.
To make it work on all SoCs, please put this code under following condition
```
#if !defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32F0X) || defined(USART_LIN_SUPPORT)
```
